name: Worker Crash Recovery
description: A long-running task used to demonstrate worker-loss recovery. If the executing worker dies, its lease expires, the recovery sweeper marks the attempt WorkerLost, and the ordinary retry path runs a new attempt on a surviving worker. timeout_seconds is set comfortably above the task's real runtime: the lease is derived from it, so a timeout below actual runtime would cause the sweeper to reclaim healthy attempts. Not publicly triggerable — this is a fault-injection workflow, run locally with the recovery-test Compose overlay.
